faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NCRTC Assistant Manager/ Civil recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NCRTC Assistant Manager/ Civil recruitment is 12 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Manager/ Civil post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./ B. Tech. (Civil) or its equivalent (Full Time) degree. A P.G. Degree/ Diploma in Construction Management is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Manager/ Civil post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for NCRTC Assistant Manager/ Civil posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Manager/ Civil position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,60,000 per month (IDA).

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Manager/ Civil post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Assistant Manager/ Civil post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NCRTC Assistant Manager/ Civil recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test/ CBT, followed by an Interview, Document Verification, and finally the creation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q8. What is the minimum post-qualification experience required?
faq.answer: A minimum of 05 years of post-qualification experience is required for the Assistant Manager/ Civil position.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the NCRTC Assistant Manager/ Civil job?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official NCRTC website or by using the 'Apply Online' link provided in the 'Important Links' section. Ensure all details are accurate before submission.
